ctx.x: Yes. You see, because I met Tio's daughter out in a country town here in New York State, and she was still kind of salty with Barney Bigard because he let Duke have this thing of, he let Duke have this thing, 'Mood Indigo' because they claim, Barney told me that Duke put more, a little more something to the tune.
